Bill.BriefDescription: Providing health benefit plans offering coverage for prostate cancer screening.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to health benefit plans offering coverage forprostate cancer screening; adding a new section to chapter 48.20 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 48.21 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 48.44 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 48.46 RCW; andproviding an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any disability insurance that is offered, issued, or renewed inthis state after December 31, 2006, which provides coverage to menforty years old and older in this state, shall offer coverage forannual screening for the early detection of prostate cancer in men overthe age of forty years, according to the prostate cancer earlydetection guidelines of the national comprehensive cancer network. Thecoverage shall not be subject to policy deductibles. (2) The benefit required in subsection (1) of this section shall inno way diminish or limit diagnostic benefits otherwise allowable undera health benefit plan. At least one screening shall be covered p. 1 SB 6188annually for any man forty years of age or older, according to theprostate cancer early detection guidelines of the nationalcomprehensive cancer network guidelines. (3) For purposes of this section, "health benefit plan" includes ahealth plan as defined in RCW 48.43.005, any state or municipal healthinsurance plan, any program funded under Title XIX of the socialsecurity act, or such other publicly funded program, and any coverageprovided by a multiple employer welfare arrangement.
